description: (Na)₂LiErCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a LiErCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the LiErCl₆ framework, Li is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ErCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Li-Cl bond lengths are 2.52 Å. Er is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form ErCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Er-Cl bond lengths are 2.59 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Li and one Er atom.
